title: Back in Black
feel: Straight eighths on the hi-hat, kick and snare locked to the riff. Mid-tempo and heavy.

title: Highway to Hell
feel: Straight eighths, big backbeat, crash into each chorus.

title: Seven Nation Army
feel: A steady kick-and-snare pulse in quarter notes, opening up to the cymbals in the big parts.

title: Smells Like Teen Spirit
feel: Driving eighths with open hats in the chorus; quiet verses, loud choruses.

title: Everlong
feel: Fast, driving eighths with a busy kick and lots of crash.

title: Mr. Brightside
feel: Fast straight eighths that keep pushing from start to finish.

title: Sweet Child O' Mine
feel: Straight rock eighths with a big snare, riding the crash in the choruses.

title: Livin' on a Prayer
feel: Straight eighths and a huge backbeat; big room, big choruses.

title: Should I Stay or Should I Go
feel: Simple straight-ahead eighths; the double-time sections are punk-fast.

title: Boulevard of Broken Dreams
feel: Slow straight eighths with a heavy backbeat.

title: Don't Stop Believin'
feel: Builds from sparse to straight driving eighths.

title: Rock and Roll
feel: Fast, loose, driving eighths with lots of crash.

title: Paranoid
feel: Fast, relentless eighths under the riff.

title: Crazy Train
feel: Driving eighths with a busy kick.

title: Every Breath You Take
feel: Light, steady eighths that stay out of the way; a soft, even feel.

title: Billie Jean
feel: A tight, dry straight-eighth groove: kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4, eighths on the hats.

title: Africa
feel: A light, syncopated pop groove with lots of space.

title: Dancing Queen
feel: Four on the floor with open hats on the offbeats.

title: Get Lucky
feel: Four on the floor, open hats between, a light disco feel.

title: Everybody Wants to Rule the World
feel: A light shuffle with a steady backbeat.

title: Superstition
feel: Tight sixteenth-note funk on the hats with ghost notes on the snare.

title: Uptown Funk
feel: Tight, punchy funk with sixteenths and accents.

title: Pride and Joy
feel: A Texas shuffle: swung eighths on the hats, strong backbeat.

title: La Grange
feel: A fast boogie shuffle.

title: Rosanna
feel: The half-time shuffle: swung ghost notes on the snare between a big backbeat on 3.

title: Three Little Birds
feel: One drop: kick and rimshot together on 3, a relaxed swung hat.

title: The Girl from Ipanema
feel: Bossa nova: soft cross-stick pattern over a light kick.

title: Oye Como Va
feel: A cha-cha groove under the organ.

title: Smooth
feel: Latin rock: syncopated, on the ride, pushing forward.

title: Take the "A" Train
feel: Medium-up swing on the ride, feathered kick, hats on 2 and 4.

title: Fly Me to the Moon
feel: Medium swing on the ride with hats on 2 and 4.

title: Still D.R.E.
feel: Laid-back hip-hop beat: kick and snare with plenty of space.

title: Juicy
feel: Boom bap: a relaxed kick-snare beat.

title: Lose Yourself
feel: A heavy, steady hip-hop beat.

title: Basket Case
feel: Fast punk eighths, loud and driving.

title: All the Small Things
feel: Pop-punk drive with a bouncy chorus.

title: Blitzkrieg Bop
feel: Fast, relentless downstroke eighths.

title: Enter Sandman
feel: Mid-tempo heavy groove, big and simple.

title: Master of Puppets
feel: Fast thrash with a driving kick.

title: Nothing Else Matters
feel: A slow 6/8 ballad that builds to big choruses.

title: Tennessee Whiskey
feel: A slow, soulful 12/8 sway.

title: Gravity
feel: A slow 12/8 blues groove with plenty of space.

title: Piano Man
feel: A waltz: boom-chick-chick in three.

title: Ring of Fire
feel: A boom-chick country two-step.
